title: Taiwan Raises 2026 Growth Forecast to 13.28%, Fastest in 48 Years
summaryZh: 主計總處上修今年經濟成長率預測至13.28%
summaryHi: ताइवान ने 2026 का विकास अनुमान बढ़ाकर 13.28% किया, जो 48 साल में सबसे तेज़ है।
summaryEs: Taiwán eleva su previsión de crecimiento para 2026 al 13,28 %, la más alta en 48 años.
summaryJa: 台湾、今年の成長率予測を13.28％に上方修正、48年ぶりの高さ。
summaryKo: 대만, 올해 성장률 전망 13.28%로 상향…48년 만에 최고.
summaryEn: Taiwan's statistics agency now expects the economy to grow 13.28% in 2026, driven by booming AI-related exports.
paragraphs: Taiwan's economy is on course for its fastest expansion in nearly half a century, after the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) raised its 2026 growth forecast to 13.28% on Friday. The figure is 2.23 percentage points higher than its August estimate and would be the strongest since 1978.

The upgrade reflects the global rush for artificial intelligence hardware, much of which is made in Taiwan. Exports of goods and services are now expected to jump 23.96%, with merchandise exports reaching a record US$938.64 billion and potentially topping US$1.11 trillion next year.

Gross domestic product grew 14.39% in the third quarter, and the agency sharply revised its fourth-quarter forecast up to 10.42%. Private investment is projected to rise 14.9%, although the forecast for household spending growth was trimmed slightly to 4.74% amid stock market swings.
Inflation is also edging up. Consumer prices are forecast to rise 2.07% this year, just above the central bank's 2% threshold, driven by crude oil, consumer electronics and food.

Tsai Yu-tai, a senior DGBAS statistician, warned of downside risks, including tighter US export controls on chips to China and possible stricter AI regulation. Growth is expected to slow to 6.51% in 2027.
Taiwan's economy is growing very fast this year. On Friday, the government's statistics office gave a new number. It thinks the economy will grow by 13.28% in 2026.
In August, the office said 11.05%. Now the number is higher. If this happens, it will be the fastest growth in 48 years.
Why? Taiwan sells a lot of computer chips and AI products to other countries. Exports may grow by almost 24% this year. Companies are also spending more money on new factories and machines.
Prices are going up a little too. Oil, food and electronics cost more. Prices may rise by about 2% this year.
Next year, the economy may grow by 6.51%. But there are some risks, like new US rules on chips.
sentZh: 台灣今年經濟成長得非常快。
星期五，政府的統計機關公布了新數字。
它認為2026年經濟將成長13.28%。
8月時，該機關說是11.05%。
現在數字更高了。
如果實現，這將是48年來最快的成長。
為什麼？
台灣賣很多電腦晶片和AI產品給其他國家。
今年出口可能成長將近24%。
企業也花更多錢在新工廠和機器上。
物價也上漲了一點。
石油、食物和電子產品變貴了。
今年物價可能上漲約2%。
明年經濟可能成長6.51%。
但也有一些風險，例如美國對晶片的新規定。

paragraphs: Taiwan's statistics agency, the DGBAS, has raised its forecast for economic growth this year to 13.28%. If this happens, it will be the fastest growth since 1978, nearly 48 years ago. In August, the agency had expected growth of 11.05%.

The main reason is the huge demand for artificial intelligence. Taiwan makes many of the chips and servers that AI needs. The agency now expects exports of goods and services to rise by almost 24%, and goods exports alone to reach a record US$938.64 billion.

The economy grew by 14.39% in the third quarter, and growth in the last three months of the year is expected to be 10.42%. Private investment should increase by 14.9%, but spending by families is growing more slowly, at about 4.74%.
Prices are also rising. Consumer prices may go up 2.07% this year, slightly above the central bank's 2% inflation threshold, because of oil, food and electronics.
An official said there were still risks, such as new US limits on chip sales to China. Growth next year is forecast at 6.51%.
sentZh: 台灣的統計機關主計總處，把今年的經濟成長預測上調到13.28%。
如果實現，這將是自1978年、將近48年前以來最快的成長。
8月時，該機關預估成長率為11.05%。
主要原因是對人工智慧的龐大需求。
台灣生產許多AI需要的晶片和伺服器。
該機關現在預估商品與服務出口將成長將近24%，光是商品出口就將達到創紀錄的9,386.4億美元。
第三季經濟成長14.39%，今年最後三個月的成長預計為10.42%。
民間投資預計增加14.9%，但家庭支出成長較慢，約4.74%。
物價也在上漲。
受石油、食物和電子產品影響，今年消費者物價可能上漲2.07%，略高於央行衡量通膨壓力的2%門檻。
一名官員表示仍有風險，例如美國對晶片銷往中國的新限制。
明年成長率預測為6.51%。

The figure is 2.23 percentage points higher than its August estimate and would be the strongest since 1978.

The upgrade reflects the global rush for artificial intelligence hardware, much of which is made in Taiwan. Exports of goods and services are now expected to jump 23.96%, with merchandise exports reaching a record US$938.64 billion and potentially topping US$1.11 trillion next year.

Tsai Yu-tai, a senior DGBAS statistician, warned of downside risks, including tighter US export controls on chips to China and possible stricter AI regulation. Growth is expected to slow to 6.51% in 2027.
sentZh: 主計總處星期五將2026年經濟成長預測上修至13.28%，台灣經濟可望迎來近半世紀以來最快的擴張。
這個數字比8月的預估高出2.23個百分點，將是1978年以來最強勁的成長。
這次上修反映全球搶購人工智慧硬體的熱潮，而這些硬體多在台灣製造。
商品與服務出口現在預計大增23.96%，商品出口將達創紀錄的9,386.4億美元，明年可能突破1.11兆美元。
第三季國內生產毛額成長14.39%，主計總處也將第四季預測大幅上修至10.42%。
民間投資預計成長14.9%，但受股市波動影響，家庭支出成長率預測小幅下修至4.74%。
通膨也在緩步上升。
受原油、消費性電子產品和食物推升，今年消費者物價預計上漲2.07%，略高於央行2%的門檻。
主計總處資深統計官員蔡鈺泰警告下行風險，包括美國收緊對中國的晶片出口管制，以及可能更嚴格的AI監管。

paragraphs: Taiwan is poised to record its most rapid economic expansion in almost five decades after the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) lifted its 2026 growth projection to 13.28%, a hefty 2.23 percentage points above its August forecast. Only 1978, when growth reached 13.56%, would rank higher.

The revision underscores how thoroughly the AI boom has reshaped the island's economy. Exports of goods and services are now expected to surge 23.96%, while merchandise exports are set to hit an unprecedented US$938.64 billion before potentially surpassing US$1.11 trillion in 2027.

Third-quarter output expanded 14.39%, and the agency raised its fourth-quarter estimate by more than five points to 10.42%. Private investment is forecast to climb 14.9%, though the forecast for private consumption growth was nudged down to 4.74%, reflecting volatility in equity markets.
Price pressures are building as well, with consumer inflation projected at 2.07%, marginally above the central bank's 2% comfort level, owing to costlier crude oil, electronics and food.

DGBAS official Tsai Yu-tai cautioned that further US curbs on chip exports to China, or tougher AI rules, could weigh on demand, adding that the agency had taken a somewhat conservative view of exports. Growth is forecast to moderate to 6.51% next year.
sentZh: 主計總處將2026年成長預測上調至13.28%，比8月預估大幅高出2.23個百分點，台灣即將創下近五十年來最快的經濟擴張。
只有成長率達13.56%的1978年排名更高。
這次上修凸顯AI熱潮已徹底重塑台灣經濟。
商品與服務出口現在預計激增23.96%，商品出口將達前所未有的9,386.4億美元，2027年更可能超過1.11兆美元。
第三季產出擴張14.39%，主計總處將第四季預估上調超過五個百分點至10.42%。
民間投資預計攀升14.9%，不過民間消費成長率預測微幅下修至4.74%，反映股市的波動。
物價壓力也在累積，由於原油、電子產品和食物變貴，消費者物價預計上漲2.07%，略高於央行2%的可接受範圍。
主計總處官員蔡鈺泰提醒，美國若進一步限制晶片出口至中國，或AI規範趨嚴，都可能壓抑需求；他並表示，主計總處對出口的看法略為保守。
明年成長預計趨緩至6.51%。

paragraphs: Taiwan's economy is set to achieve its most remarkable growth rate in almost half a century. On Friday, the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) revised its 2026 projection upward to 13.28%, an increase of 2.23 percentage points on its August estimate and second only to the 13.56% recorded in 1978.

This exceptional performance is attributable primarily to the worldwide demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure, a substantial proportion of which is manufactured in Taiwan. Exports of goods and services are anticipated to expand by 23.96%, with merchandise exports projected to reach an unprecedented US$938.64 billion this year.

Domestic indicators present a more nuanced picture. While private investment is forecast to rise by 14.9%, the forecast for household consumption growth was revised marginally downward to 4.74%, which officials linked to fluctuations in the stock market. Meanwhile, consumer inflation is expected to reach 2.07%, slightly exceeding the central bank's 2% threshold as a consequence of higher prices for crude oil, electronics and food.

Nevertheless, the outlook is not without uncertainty. Tsai Yu-tai, a senior DGBAS statistician, identified potential headwinds, notably additional US restrictions on semiconductor exports to China and the prospect of more stringent AI regulation.
Consequently, the agency expects growth to moderate to 6.51% in 2027, a respectable figure by international standards.
sentZh: 台灣經濟今年將創下近半世紀以來最亮眼的成長率。
主計總處星期五將2026年預測上修至13.28%，比8月預估增加2.23個百分點，僅次於1978年的13.56%。
如此出色的表現主要歸因於全球對人工智慧基礎設施的需求，而其中相當大的比例在台灣製造。
商品與服務出口預計擴張23.96%，今年商品出口預計將達前所未有的9,386.4億美元。
國內指標呈現的面貌則較為複雜。
民間投資預計成長14.9%，但家庭消費成長率預測小幅下修至4.74%，官員認為這與股市波動有關。
同時，由於原油、電子產品和食物價格上漲，消費者物價預計上漲2.07%，略高於央行2%的門檻。
儘管如此，前景並非沒有不確定性。
主計總處資深統計官員蔡鈺泰指出潛在的不利因素，特別是美國對中國半導體出口的進一步限制，以及AI監管可能更加嚴格。
因此，主計總處預計2027年成長將放緩至6.51%，以國際標準而言仍是可觀的數字。

may.ex: Kids may start school at four.
may.ja: …かもしれない；…することがある

merchandise.en: goods that are bought and sold
merchandise.ex: The market sells local merchandise every Saturday.

moderate.en: to become less strong or fast

example.en: Growth is expected to moderate to 3% next year.
example.zh: 預計明年成長將放緩至3%。

note.usage: 常見 growth/inflation moderates；moderate to + 數字。

noteHi.exampleTr: अगले साल विकास धीमा होकर 3% रहने की उम्मीद है।

noteEs.exampleTr: Se espera que el crecimiento se modere al 3 % el próximo año.
noteEs.usage: Se usa growth moderates; moderate to + cifra.

noteJa.exampleTr: 来年の成長は3％に鈍化する見込みだ。

noteEn.meaning: to become less strong, fast or extreme.

money.ex: I saved money for a new bike.

most.en: used to make the superlative: to the greatest degree
most.ex: This is the most beautiful beach in Spain.

much.ex: The new phone is much faster.

nevertheless.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.

new.ex: She bought a new coat for winter.

next.ex: I will visit you next week.

not.ex: I do not like cold tea.

notably.en: clearly; in a way people notice
notably.ex: The weather was notably warmer this week.

nuanced.ja: 微妙な；ニュアンスのある
nuanced.ex: The report gives a nuanced view of the market.

example.en: The data paint a more nuanced picture of the economy.
example.zh: 數據呈現出更細緻的經濟面貌。

note.meaning: 細緻的；考慮細微差別的（非黑白分明）。

noteHi.exampleTr: आँकड़े अर्थव्यवस्था की अधिक बारीक तस्वीर दिखाते हैं।

noteEs.exampleTr: Los datos muestran una imagen más matizada de la economía.

noteJa.exampleTr: データは経済のより微妙な姿を示している。

noteKo.exampleTr: 데이터는 경제의 더 미묘한 모습을 보여 준다.

noteEn.meaning: showing small but important differences; not simple.

nudged.zh: 小幅調整（nudged down：微幅下修）

number.ex: The number of tourists is rising.

official.en: approved by the government or an authority
official.ex: The official report came out today.

officials.ex: Officials met to discuss the plan.

oil.en: a fuel taken from the ground
oil.ex: The country earns most of its money from oil.

on.ex: Voting will go on for nine days.

outbound.en: going out of a country or place
outbound.ex: Outbound flights were full this week.

outlook.en: a forecast of what will probably happen

percentage.en: an amount expressed as part of 100
percentage.ex: A small percentage of students failed the test.

points.en: points out: mentions, draws attention to
points.ex: The teacher pointed out my spelling mistakes.

poised.ex: The team is poised to win the cup.

potential.ex: We discussed potential problems with the plan.

present.ex: At present, the shop is closed.

price.en: the money you pay for something
price.ex: The price of bread went up.

prices.en: amounts of money paid for things

primarily.ex: The course is primarily for adults.

private.en: not owned or run by the government
private.ex: She works for a private company.

product.ex: This product is made in Japan.

projection.en: an estimate of a future amount
projection.ex: Sales projections for next year are good.

proportion.ex: A large proportion of staff work from home.

prospect.en: the idea of a possible future event
prospect.ex: There is a real prospect of flooding.

quarter.ex: Sales rose in the first quarter.

rank.en: to have a position on a list
rank.ex: The city ranks first for safety.

rapid.ex: There has been rapid growth in the city.

rate.en: level or amount, often a percentage
rate.ex: The success rate of the treatment is high.

reach.en: get to an age, level or agreement
reach.ex: They hope to reach a decision soon.

reached.ex: The news reached us late at night.

reaching.ex: Prices kept rising, reaching a new high.

reason.ex: There is no reason to worry.

record.en: the highest or lowest ever (record low)

recorded.ex: The hottest day was recorded in July.

reflecting.en: showing or being a sign of something
reflecting.ex: Sales rose, reflecting greater demand for electric cars.

reflects.en: shows or is caused by something

reshaped.en: changed the form or structure of

respectable.ex: The team finished in a respectable fourth place.

example.en: Even 6% would be a respectable rate for most economies.
example.zh: 即使6%對多數經濟體也是可觀的成長率。

note.meaning: 不錯的；可觀的（夠好，但不驚人）。
note.usage: 常見 a respectable figure/result/score；respectable growth。

noteHi.exampleTr: अधिकांश अर्थव्यवस्थाओं के लिए 6% भी अच्छी दर होगी।

noteEs.exampleTr: Incluso un 6 % sería una tasa respetable para la mayoría de economías.

noteJa.exampleTr: 6％でも多くの経済にとって立派な数字だ。

noteEn.meaning: good enough or fairly large, though not outstanding.

restrictions.en: rules that limit what people can do

revised.ex: The plan was revised after the meeting.

revision.en: a change to make something more correct
revision.zh: 修訂（subject to revision：可能修改）

rise.ex: There was a rise in prices.

rules.en: official instructions about what is allowed
rules.ex: The school has strict rules about phones.

rush.en: a sudden race by many to do something
rush.ex: There was a rush to buy shares.

said.ex: She said the shop was closed.

second.ex: This is my second visit to Paris.

sells.en: gives something in exchange for money

semiconductor.en: material used to make computer chips
semiconductor.ex: Taiwan has a large semiconductor industry.

senior.ex: A senior manager answered our letter.

servers.en: computers that store data and run services for others
servers.ex: The servers are kept in a cold room.

services.ex: The bus service runs every hour.

set.ex: She set up a new email account.

shipments.en: loads of goods sent from one place to another

slow.ex: The bank was slow to answer my email.

slowly.ex: The car moved slowly in the snow.

some.ex: Some fifty people came to the meeting.

somewhat.ex: The weather was somewhat better today.

standards.en: levels of quality that are expected
standards.ex: The hotel has very high standards.

statistician.en: a person who works with statistics
statistician.ex: A statistician checked the survey data.

statistics.en: numbers that give facts about something
statistics.ex: Statistics show more people cycle to work.

still.ex: She is still waiting for the bus.

stock.en: the total number of homes available
stock.ex: The city's housing stock is old.

stricter.ex: The school has stricter rules this year.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las normas de seguridad alimentaria son rigurosas.
noteEs.usage: Más formal que strict; stringent rules.

noteJa.exampleTr: 食品安全規則は厳格だ。

strongest.ex: The strongest gusts hit the coast at dawn.

substantial.ex: The new road needs a substantial amount of money.

example.en: The storm caused substantial damage to the houses.
example.zh: 暴風對房屋造成了相當大的損害。

note.meaning: 大量的、相當大的；文中指愛爾蘭南部也可能出現強陣風。
note.usage: 形容詞，常見 substantial amount/increase/damage；副詞 substantially。

noteHi.exampleTr: तूफ़ान ने घरों को काफ़ी नुकसान पहुँचाया।
noteHi.meaning: काफ़ी बड़ा या ज़्यादा; यहाँ दक्षिणी क्षेत्रों में तेज़ हवाएँ संभव हैं।

noteEs.exampleTr: La tormenta causó daños considerables en las casas.
noteEs.meaning: Considerable, importante; aquí, rachas fuertes en el sur.

noteJa.exampleTr: 嵐は家屋にかなりの被害をもたらした。
noteJa.meaning: かなりの、相当な。記事では南部でも強い突風が吹く可能性を表す。
noteJa.usage: 形容詞。substantial amount/increase/damage などで使う。

noteKo.meaning: 상당한, 많은. 기사에서는 남부 지역에도 강한 돌풍이 불 수 있다는 뜻이다.

noteEn.meaning: large in amount, size or importance.

surge.ex: There was a surge in online shopping this month.

surpassing.ex: Sales are close to surpassing last year's total.

taiwan.en: an island country in East Asia

taken.ex: They have taken on a big task.

target.en: a result you plan to achieve
target.ex: The shop met its sales target.

there.ex: We went to the park and played there.

thinks.ex: He thinks the film is too long.

third.ex: The third quarter ends in September.

third-quarter.en: in the period from July to September
third-quarter.ex: Third-quarter profits were better than expected.

though.ex: It was late. We stayed, though.

threshold.ex: Income above the threshold is taxed.

tighter.ex: The city wants tighter rules on parking.

too.ex: The coffee is too hot to drink.

topping.ex: Sales are topping one million units.

tougher.ex: The city wants tougher rules on parking.

uncertainty.en: a feeling of not knowing what will happen
uncertainty.ex: There is uncertainty about the future.

underscores.en: shows clearly how important something is
underscores.ex: The result underscores the need for reform.

example.zh: 價格達到前所未有的水平。

noteEs.exampleTr: Los precios alcanzaron niveles sin precedentes.

noteJa.exampleTr: 価格は前例のない水準に達した。

up.en: up for grabs: available to get
up.ex: Two seats on the council are up for grabs.
up.hi: (up for grabs) पाने के लिए उपलब्ध

upgrade.en: a change that makes something better
upgrade.ex: The station needs a major upgrade.

upward.ex: There is upward pressure on rents.

view.ex: In my view, the plan is too costly.
view.zh: 看法（in their view：在他們看來）

volatility.en: the quality of changing quickly and without warning

warned.ex: Experts warned of a hot summer.

weigh.en: to have a bad effect on (weigh on)
weigh.ex: High rates weigh on house prices.

well.en: in a good or satisfactory way

were.ex: The shops were closed on Sunday.

will.en: used to talk about the future
will.ex: The new bridge will open next year.

would.ex: A new park would help the town.
